title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, improve caching and upgrade actions
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow (lint+test+release) has grown long-running and fragile; builds are slower due to unrelated steps running for docs and small repo changes, and cache invalidation semantics are brittle across jobs. This PR splits the monolithic pipeline into separate lint, test, and release workflows, standardizes cache keys across JS/TS/Go jobs, upgrades several GitHub Actions to latest stable versions, and applies a hygiene pass to disable unused releases workflows for forks. The description below is a single continuous string. Changes include: - New workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml - Consolidated Node.js setup and cache steps into actions/common/setup-node-cache.sh - Bumped actions: actions/checkout@v4 -> v4 (no-op), actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4 - Improved caching keys based on repo path, package-lock.json and yarn.lock fingerprints to reduce unnecessary cache misses - Separated release job to only run on protected branches and tagged commits - Added lightweight smoke-test step to release workflow to avoid bad rollouts - Added matrix split for test jobs to run fast unit tests in parallel and long integration tests on scheduled runners - Updated CI status badges and pipeline documentation in docs/ci.md Testing & rollout: ran full pipeline against branch and a fork; fixed two flaky tests discovered by matrixing; verified cache hits on repeated runs (see CI checks below). Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor actions for 48h, revert if release workflow causes regressions. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows created and wired into existing config - [x] Node and cache scripts consolidated - [x] Actions updated and smoke-tests added - [x] Verified cache hits on repeated runs - [x] Reviewed by infra and eng leads Related: Linear ENG-4123 (ci reliability), ENG-4200 (ci performance).

release_notes: Split CI workflows (lint/test/release) to reduce runtime and failure blast radius; consolidated Node/caching helpers; bumped core GitHub Actions versions; added smoke-test to release workflow; improved cache keys to reduce misses.
notes: This PR is primarily repo hygiene and CI improvements. No runtime or API changes. Monitor release workflow closely for 48 hours post-merge. If release uploads fail, revert commit e8f2c4a and re-run.
